messages:
elaine: Quick PR up that cleans up the console observability dashboard example and the inline YAML for the tracing hook. I noticed the sample uses old `trace_key` and a bunch of internal links are 404ing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :wave:

matt: Thanks — can you paste which files are affected? I can grep and try to fix links in the build step :eyes:

elaine: main ones: `docs/console/dashboards/getting-started.md` (dashboard sample block), `docs/observability/tracing/hooks.md` (inline YAML) and the embed snippet in `docs/console/examples/kv-cache.md`. Also some anchors changed after the tracing hook rename.

lisa: I can take the examples and run the snippet linter. Is the change just `trace_key` -> `traceId` or is there more? :thinking:

ken: It's `trace_id` -> `trace_key`? Wait — runtime rename was `trace_id` -> `trace_key` last quarter, and then we flipped to `traceId` in the SDK shim. The docs are mixing all three. We should standardize on `traceId` in examples and add a short compatibility note.

elaine: Ugh, yes that's the mess. My PR tries to normalize to `traceId` and adds a redirect for the old `trace_key` anchor, but the CI linkcheck is failing because of an absolute internal link that changed.

docbot: linkchecker: ❌ 1 broken link in docs/console/dashboards/getting-started.md -> /docs/observability/tracing/hooks#old-anchor

matt: I can patch the anchor redirects in the doc site config. Is there a preferred short paragraph for the compatibility note? Keep it ~2 lines.

lisa: I'll draft the 2-line note: "Note: older SDKs and runtime variants emitted `trace_key` or `trace_id`. When upgrading, prefer `traceId` — Redwood's runtime accepts the legacy keys for a transition period." Will add to the YAML example as a comment.

elaine: Perfect. Can you also run `yarn docs:linkcheck` and paste the failing lines?

lisa: running now...

lisa: ```
$ yarn docs:linkcheck
> linkchecker
docs/console/dashboards/getting-started.md:45 Broken link -> /docs/observability/tracing/hooks#old-anchor
``` :mag:

ken: For the YAML snippet, update the keys and add this minimal example (feel free to copy):
```
tracing:
  enabled: true
  traceId: "${{ env.TRACE_ID }}" # prefer traceId; runtime accepts legacy keys
```

matt: I'll add the redirect rule to `docusaurus.config.js` under `redirects` so the old anchor resolves. Pushing a tiny commit now.

matt: pushed 6f3a9b — redirects added, also added a note in the migration guide.

elaine: CI re-run shows linkcheck passed but the snippet linter found a formatting nit.

docbot: snippet-linter: ⚠️ docs/observability/tracing/hooks.md: sample 3 — trailing spaces in YAML block

lisa: quick fix in the PR. also removing an absolute URL and replacing with relative link.

lisa: done and force-pushed to the branch. asking for one more review @matt @ken :rocket:

ken: LGTM, ran the sample locally with `./scripts/run-local-sample.sh --sample dashboard` and verified the traceId field is parsed by the shim. :white_check_mark:

matt: Reviewed, approves. :thumbsup: Elaine, want me to merge once tests green?

elaine: Yes please. small deploy after merge is fine, no rush.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler: scheduled docs deploy for 2023-12-01T22:00:00Z to pick up redirects and snippet fixes. :calendar:

elaine: thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a short note in the docs changelog about the trace key rename and the compatibility window. :memo:
